reasons.plausibility: Machine-learning potentials for ab initio-level accuracy are well-established, and using curated data to capture anharmonic and vibrational effects in multicomponent systems is scientifically credible although challenging.
reasons.testability: They specify a direct head-to-head benchmark against full AIMD and TOR-TILD, with quantitative error and speed thresholds that can clearly confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: If validated, it would provide a fast, systematic method for obtaining high-temperature free energies and fusion properties in complex high-entropy alloys—a major practical need in materials design.
